# Calendar discovery tests separate detected UI results, redirect credentials and registration

Full test bodies read: unit detection121 lines, CalDAV browser367, ICS browser42,
helper175 and Account Hub sync519. Fixture server scripts are test support, not
production endpoints. dns.sjs/proincipal.sjs/calendars.sjs require Authorization
header presence and return principal→home set→two calendar hrefs/name/color data.
Calendar href endpoints named calendar.sjs/calendar2.sjs are virtual result URIs;
no tracked files at those paths were found. Do not mark those files scanned.
calendars.sjs encodes UTF-8 bytes before response write to preserve non-ASCII title.

Unit direct checks: normal ICS result and302 keep-original URI; same-site redirect
records host with Authorization; different-site redirect records attempted request
and asserts zero authorized requests. The other-site test catches discovery
failure without checking its exact error class. ICSServer fixture and configured
proxy govern those paths. These do not prove every TLS downgrade/OAuth boundary.

CalDAV direct browser checks via head_discovery include Find-button/focus/location
flow, DNS query names, list count/URI/name/color, read-only privilege variants,
missing-resource-type principal/home-set fallback, certificate error status and
accepted exception. Certificate case also checks saved override and telemetry
category/protocol/port/UI. Helper cancels after list checks; no subscription
assertion follows from those tests. Browser ICS checks authenticated list URI/name.

Account Hub second task checks selection controls/counts/Fluent changes then
registers one selected calendar, awaits manager callback and checks name/type.
It records two discovered calendars in telemetry. Its skip task checks visible
success outcome after Skip; it does not check actual CalDAV request cancellation.
Test observer is explicitly removed on registration. These are distinct direct
checks versus executed code without a matching assertion.

No browser or unit detection tests were run in this pass. Native site test pass
belongs to its separate build-scoped record. Possible links to failure cleanup,
new empty location, dummy PUT, local-file permissions, add-on cycles and stale
dialog results remain unverified. Existing test names alone do not resolve them.
Root browser manifest18/22/58 registers helper/fixtures/CalDAV/ICS; root unit
manifest92 registers test_detection. No test existence is treated as a pass.

## Evidence scope

Thunderbird `87d0159c7149a43253964c2cb6917939557dc799`; Firefox `1a097ed8d31f6b307a5d0ebc34a82ceaf7f3727b`. Paths and line ranges or named task anchors
refer to these exact commits. Read with `git show REVISION:repository-relative-path`.
Direct source relationships, inferred effects and unresolved dispatch are separated.
Static test assertions do not establish a pass. Product run results identify the
observed build and its unknown native revision. Private logs, indexes and local
paths stay outside shared knowledge. Suite and deliberate instructions are unchanged.
